description: This file defines the class 'Blog' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Extension\Opencart\Module' namespace. It extends a system engine model and contains a method 'getArticles' which retrieves blog articles from the database with support for filtering, sorting, and caching.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Model class for managing blog articles within OpenCart, provides a method to fetch articles with filtering, sorting, and caching.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of articles from the database based on provided filter criteria, supports sorting, limits, and caching.
